name: HorizontalBarChart
intent: A complete horizontal bar chart component that composes ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, HorizontalBarGroup, and ChartFooter. Uses D3 for data scaling; all styling comes from the CSS token cascade (`--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` via `generateDataVisCSS`, surface/typography tokens via `useBrandCSSNew`, both injected at `@layer brand`) — there is no runtime JS token resolver and no `modes` prop.
